user.title: Connect a JURA machine
user.description: Enter the IP address of the Wi-Fi Connect dongle and pick your machine model. The next step pairs Home Assistant with the machine, so switch it on and stay in front of its display.

data_description.host: Address of the Wi-Fi Connect dongle in your network.
data_description.model: The model name including the regional variant, e.g. "E8 (SD)". Type to search the list.
data_description.pin: Only needed if a setup PIN is set on the machine. Leave empty otherwise.

pair_failed.title: Pairing failed
pair_failed.description: Pairing with {host} did not work. Make sure the machine is switched on and its display is active, then try again.

data_description.pin: The setup PIN of the machine. Leave empty if none is set.

reauth_confirm.title: Pair again
reauth_confirm.description: The machine at {host} no longer accepts the stored credentials. Switch it on and confirm the connection request on its display after you submit.

reconfigure.title: Change the address
reconfigure.description: Enter the new IP address of the Wi-Fi Connect dongle.

progress.pair: Look at the display of the machine at {host} and confirm the connection request with **OK** within 60 seconds.

error.cannot_connect: The machine did not answer. Is it switched on and reachable from Home Assistant?
error.invalid_auth: The machine rejected the stored credentials.
error.pairing_timeout: The connection request was not confirmed on the machine in time.
error.pairing_rejected: The machine refused the connection request.
error.unknown: Unexpected error, see the Home Assistant log.

abort.reauth_successful: Pairing succeeded, the machine is connected again.

data_description.scan_interval: Seconds between two polls. The dongle accepts only one connection at a time, so do not go too low.
data_description.enable_brewing: Add a button per drink that brews it with the factory-default recipe. Make sure a cup is in place before pressing.

auth_failed.message: The machine rejected the stored credentials. Pair it again.

product_blocked.message: {product} cannot be brewed right now. Check the machine for active alerts.
